C-CI-CLOSURE-EVIDENCE.Summary: Accept first closure of one registered change on the same pull request using a trusted prior approved run and fresh current checks.

Goals.Goal: Verify prior authorization and current checks independently.

Constraints.Constraint: Trusted workflow only, same PR and base.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Offline two-run positive and rejection controls plus independent review.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Match base, PR, ancestry, policy, trusted issuer, snapshot and attempt. Reject missing, stale, ambiguous or mixed evidence. Lifetime at most seven days. First closure on push stays blocked.
Preserve all existing gates, local behavior, and independent review. No remote activation, product edits or Git operations on the main checkout.
